instructions: Upload the reference painting from Timothy Holt's book into Tripo3D Studio (Image-to-3D) or paste the Text-to-3D prompt. Export as .glb and save into assets/models/<id>.glb. The Pilgrim Walk engine automatically detects the .glb file, applies the painterly oil-on-linen shader, and swaps it into the 3D world.
